    hi = int(kb.max())

        lst = buckets.get(lo)
        if lst is None:
            buckets[lo] = [t]
        else:
            lst.append(t)
        return
    off = kb - lo
    r = hi - lo
    if r < 65536:
        if r < 256:

        else:
            order = np.argsort(off.astype(np.uint16), kind='stable')
        ts = t[order]
        p = 0
        j = lo
        for cn in np.bincount(off).tolist():
            if cn:
                q = p + cn
                lst = buckets.get(j)
                if lst is None:
                    buckets[j] = [ts[p:q]]
                else:
                    lst.append(ts[p:q])
                p = q
            j += 1
    else:
        order = np.argsort(off, kind='stable')
        ts = t[order]
        ks = off[order]
        cut = (np.flatnonzero(ks[1:] != ks[:-1]) + 1).tolist()
        st = [0] + cut
        en = cut + [int(ts.size)]
        keys = ks[st].tolist()
        for i in range(len(st)):
            j = lo + keys[i]
            lst = buckets.get(j)
            if lst is None:
                buckets[j] = [ts[st[i]:en[i]]]
            else:
                lst.append(ts[st[i]:en[i]])

    if isd[-1]:
        bnd = np.concatenate((bnd, np.array([n], dtype=np.int64)))
    starts = bnd[0::2]
    stops = bnd[1::2]

    ends = stops - 1

        l = lens[act]
        k = 1
        mult = 10

            k += 1
            mult *= 10

            if not m.any():

            act = act[m]
            e = e[m]
            l = l[m]

    M = int(vals[1])
    Q = int(vals[2])

    ev = E[1::3]
    ew = E[2::3]

                    continue

            b = min(buckets)
            chunks = buckets.pop(b)
            lowd = b << shift
            if len(chunks) == 1:
                c = np.sort(chunks[0])
            else:
                c = np.concatenate(chunks)
                c.sort()
            d = dist[c]
            m = (d >> shift) == b
            m[1:] &= c[1:] != c[:-1]
            c = c[m]
            cn = int(c.size)

            if cn == 0:
                continue
            win_nodes += cn

                v = c % N
                offs = c - v
            else:
                v = c
            cnt = deg[v]

                continue

            idx += np.arange(tot, dtype=np.int64)

            nd = wt[idx]
            nd += np.repeat(d, cnt)

            t = t[m]
            if t.size == 0:

            nd = nd[m]

            pdv = pdv[m]
